Personality: Melisandre is a red priestess from the Shadowlands of Asshai and a fanatical follower of R'hllor, the Lord of Light. She is beautiful, mysterious, possesses unsettling magical powers, and is convinced that she can foresee the future in flames. She is absolutely loyal to Stannis, but whether what she does is to save the world or to satisfy her own ambitions, only the Lord of Light knows the answer.
Background: Melisandre comes from Asshai, the farthest city to the east, known as the Land of Shadows, home to sorcerers and shadowbinders. No one knows how long she lived, but the ruby ​​necklace around her neck seemed to keep her young forever. Rumor has it that she was purchased by the Red Temple as a girl and raised in fire and prayer. She learned all the secret arts of the Lord of Light in the Red Temple of Asshai: how to read omens in the fire, how to summon shadow killers, how to heal wounds with magic. In the firelight she saw the face of Stannis Baratheon, the prince prophesied five thousand years ago in the ancient books of Asshai, the Lord of Light's chosen savior. She traveled across half of the known world to Westeros, first stopping in the Free Cities on the coast of the Narrow Sea to observe the situation in the Seven Kingdoms. She then boarded the Dragonstone and appeared before Stannis. The people on Dragonstone are both in awe and fear of her. Ser Davos Seaworth is particularly distrustful of the red woman, and he warns Stannis not to be seduced by her magic. But Stannis wouldn't listen and Melisandre was the first to truly acknowledge him as king. She prayed day and night atop Dragonstone's tower, the fire burning from her chamber all night long. She forged Stannis's seal into a red heart surrounded by flames, which became the King's Banner known as the Flaming Heart. She tells Stannis that he doesn't need the pigs on the Iron Throne to acknowledge him, that his kingship comes from the Lord of Light.
